scenarios.name: grouped-scalar-conversion-without-synthetic-recovery
scenarios.limitation: Only positive evaluation instants drive the local scheduler. Native same-threshold scalar SQL polling was inconclusive; its configuration/error/history observations still replay. The scalar OK control allows seven additional local seconds for the deterministic one-minute deadline, within the same metric bucket.

sources.role: Shared bounded CLI transport and success/error decoder; temporary probe source is embedded below.

sources.content:
import ast
from datetime import datetime, timezone
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import re
import subprocess
import sys
import time
import uuid

ROOT = Path('/home/r/dev/minor/stackd')
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / 'scripts/aws'))
from aws_cli import run, result

OUT = ROOT / 'testdata/aws/cloudwatch/metric_insights_contributor_conversion.json'
PREFIX = 'sd-mi-convert-' + uuid.uuid4().hex[:12]
ALARM = PREFIX
NS = 'Stackd/InsightsConversion/' + PREFIX
DIMS = [{'Name': 'Team', 'Value': 'a'}]
ENV = dict(os.environ, AWS_REGION='us-west-2', AWS_DEFAULT_REGION='us-west-2', AWS_MAX_ATTEMPTS='1', AWS_PAGER='', AWS_IGNORE_CONFIGURED_ENDPOINT_URLS='true')
for key in list(ENV):
    if key.startswith('AWS_ENDPOINT_URL'):
        del ENV[key]
CAP = {
    'caller_account': '000000000000', 'region': 'us-west-2',
    'started_at': datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
    'cli_version': subprocess.check_output(['aws', '--version'], text=True).strip(),
    'sources': [{'url': 'https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatch/latest/APIReference/API_' + op + '.html'} for op in ['PutMetricAlarm', 'DescribeAlarmContributors', 'DescribeAlarmHistory']] + [
        {'url': 'https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatch/latest/monitoring/multi-time-series-alarm.html'},
        {'path': __file__, 'content': Path(__file__).read_text()},
    ],
    'owned_resources': {'alarm': ALARM, 'namespace': NS, 'metric_name': 'Load', 'dimensions': DIMS},
    'protocol': {'phase_timeout_seconds': 240, 'poll_interval_seconds': 20, 'maximum_metric_samples': 40, 'alarm_count': 1, 'metric_identity_count': 1, 'actions_enabled': False, 'account_settings_modified': False, 'publication': '100 at current timestamps, at most one sample per minute. No future samples or SetAlarmState. Grouped to scalar conversions keep threshold 50; separate scalar threshold 200 changes provide positive OK control before returning to grouped threshold 50.'},
    'observations': [], 'evaluations': [], 'limitations': [
        'Single native execution, one metric identity; no claim about other aggregations, multiple contributors, or other regions.',
        'No notification endpoints or action delivery observed. Metric samples cannot be deleted and naturally persist.',
        'Repeated unchanged API reads are not fresh evaluation evidence. Scalar ALARM evaluation requires queryDate after conversion and nonempty recentDatapoints. Scalar OK control requires a fresh data-backed evaluation at threshold 200. Grouped reappearance requires a later contributor transition timestamp.',
        'History is inspected at recorded bounded instants only; absence does not prove no later asynchronous history.',
    ],
}
last_publication_minute = None
sample_count = 0
known_id = None
created = False

def save():
    OUT.write_text(json.dumps(CAP, indent=2) + '\n')

def call(label, operation, parameters, service='cloudwatch'):
    started = time.time()
    proc = run(service, operation, parameters, ENV, options=['--debug', '--no-paginate', '--cli-connect-timeout', '10', '--cli-read-timeout', '30'], timeout=45)
    value = result(proc, debug=True)
    if value['code'] == 'CLIError':
        raise RuntimeError(operation + ': ' + proc.stderr[-1200:])
    ids = re.findall(r'<RequestId>([^<]+)</RequestId>', proc.stderr)
    if ids:
        value['request_id'] = ids[-1]
    CAP['observations'].append({'label': label, 'service': service, 'operation': operation, 'input': parameters, 'request_started_ms': round(started * 1000), 'request_finished_ms': round(time.time() * 1000), 'result': value})
    save()
    return value

def require(label, operation, parameters, service='cloudwatch'):
    value = call(label, operation, parameters, service)
    if value['code'] != 'Success':
        raise RuntimeError(label + ': ' + json.dumps(value))
    return value['output']

def publish(label):
    global last_publication_minute, sample_count
    minute = int(time.time()) // 60
    if minute == last_publication_minute:
        return
    if sample_count >= 40:
        raise RuntimeError('Publication bound exceeded')
    require(label + '-publish', 'put-metric-data', {'Namespace': NS, 'MetricData': [{'MetricName': 'Load', 'Dimensions': DIMS, 'Timestamp': datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(), 'Value': 100, 'Unit': 'Count'}]})
    last_publication_minute = minute
    sample_count += 1

def config(mode, threshold=50):
    value = {'AlarmName': ALARM, 'ActionsEnabled': False, 'EvaluationPeriods': 1, 'DatapointsToAlarm': 1, 'Threshold': threshold, 'ComparisonOperator': 'GreaterThanThreshold', 'TreatMissingData': 'notBreaching'}
    if mode == 'metric':
        value.update(Namespace=NS, MetricName='Load', Dimensions=DIMS, Period=60, Statistic='Maximum')
    else:
        sql = 'SELECT MAX(Load) FROM "' + NS + '"'
        if mode == 'grouped':
            sql += ' GROUP BY Team ORDER BY MAX() DESC'
        value['Metrics'] = [{'Id': 'q', 'Expression': sql, 'Period': 60, 'ReturnData': True}]
    return value

def stamp(value):
    return datetime.fromisoformat(value.replace('Z', '+00:00')).timestamp()

def history(label):
    params = {'AlarmName': ALARM, 'ScanBy': 'TimestampAscending', 'MaxRecords': 100, 'HistoryItemType': 'AlarmContributorStateUpdate'}
    if known_id:
        params['AlarmContributorId'] = known_id
    return require(label, 'describe-alarm-history', params)

def inspect(label):
    call(label + '-contributors', 'describe-alarm-contributors', {'AlarmName': ALARM})
    history(label + '-id-history')
    require(label + '-alarm', 'describe-alarms', {'AlarmNames': [ALARM]})

def evaluate(label, mode, expected, after):
    global known_id
    deadline = time.monotonic() + 240
    attempt = 0
    while time.monotonic() < deadline:
        attempt += 1
        poll = label + '-poll-' + str(attempt)
        publish(poll)
        data = require(poll + '-alarm', 'describe-alarms', {'AlarmNames': [ALARM]})
        alarm = data.get('MetricAlarms', [{}])[0]
        contributors = call(poll + '-contributors', 'describe-alarm-contributors', {'AlarmName': ALARM})
        evidence = None
        if mode == 'grouped':
            active = contributors.get('output', {}).get('AlarmContributors', [])
            fresh = [c for c in active if stamp(c['StateTransitionedTimestamp']) > after]
            if alarm.get('StateValue') == expected and fresh:
                known_id = fresh[0]['ContributorId']
                evidence = {'type': 'fresh-contributor-transition', 'contributor': fresh[0], 'alarm_state': alarm['StateValue']}
        else:
            reason = json.loads(alarm.get('StateReasonData') or '{}')
            query = reason.get('queryDate')
            if alarm.get('StateValue') == expected and query and stamp(query) > after and reason.get('recentDatapoints'):
                evidence = {'type': 'fresh-data-backed-scalar-evaluation', 'state': expected, 'reason_data': reason, 'state_updated_timestamp': alarm.get('StateUpdatedTimestamp')}
        if evidence:
            CAP['evaluations'].append({'phase': label, 'positive': True, 'after_seconds': after, 'poll_label': poll, 'evidence': evidence})
            history(label + '-evaluated-id-history')
            save()
            print(label + ': positive evaluation', flush=True)
            return
        time.sleep(20)
    CAP['evaluations'].append({'phase': label, 'positive': False, 'after_seconds': after, 'limitation': 'No qualifying fresh evaluation within 240 seconds; unchanged reads are not success.'})
    save()
    raise RuntimeError(label + ': fresh evaluation timed out')

try:
    actor = require('identity', 'get-caller-identity', {}, 'sts')
    CAP['actor'] = actor
    if actor['Account'] != '000000000000':
        raise RuntimeError('Unexpected account')
    absent = require('preflight-alarm-absence', 'describe-alarms', {'AlarmNames': [ALARM]})
    if absent.get('MetricAlarms') or absent.get('CompositeAlarms'):
        raise RuntimeError('Owned name unexpectedly exists')
    publish('initial')
    initial_after = time.time()
    require('create-grouped', 'put-metric-alarm', config('grouped'))
    created = True
    evaluate('initial-grouped-alarm', 'grouped', 'ALARM', initial_after)
    CAP['initial_contributor_id'] = known_id
    for mode in ['scalar-sql', 'metric']:
        before = time.time()
        require('convert-to-' + mode, 'put-metric-alarm', config(mode))
        inspect(mode + '-immediate')
        evaluate(mode + '-same-threshold-alarm', mode, 'ALARM', before)
        control = time.time()
        require(mode + '-raise-threshold-positive-control', 'put-metric-alarm', config(mode, 200))
        evaluate(mode + '-positive-ok-control', mode, 'OK', control)
        inspect(mode + '-settled')
        back = time.time()
        require(mode + '-return-to-grouped', 'put-metric-alarm', config('grouped'))
        inspect(mode + '-grouped-immediate')
        evaluate(mode + '-grouped-reappearance', 'grouped', 'ALARM', back)
        CAP.setdefault('reappearance_identity', []).append({'from': mode, 'initial_id': CAP['initial_contributor_id'], 'reappeared_id': known_id, 'same_id': known_id == CAP['initial_contributor_id']})
    require('final-all-history', 'describe-alarm-history', {'AlarmName': ALARM, 'ScanBy': 'TimestampAscending', 'MaxRecords': 100})
except Exception as exc:
    CAP['failure'] = str(exc)
    print('Capture failure: ' + str(exc), flush=True)
finally:
    if created:
        require('cleanup-delete-alarm', 'delete-alarms', {'AlarmNames': [ALARM]})
        remaining = require('cleanup-describe-absence', 'describe-alarms', {'AlarmNames': [ALARM]})
        contributors = call('cleanup-contributors-absence', 'describe-alarm-contributors', {'AlarmName': ALARM})
        history('cleanup-retained-id-history')
        CAP['cleanup'] = {'alarm_absence_verified': not remaining.get('MetricAlarms') and not remaining.get('CompositeAlarms'), 'contributor_lookup_code': contributors['code'], 'metric_samples_persist_naturally': True, 'published_samples': sample_count}
    CAP['finished_at'] = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
    save()
    print(json.dumps({'fixture': str(OUT), 'failure': CAP.get('failure'), 'cleanup': CAP.get('cleanup')}), flush=True)

# Follow-up retains the first invocation's exact source, observations and cleanup.
# Reuses its single owned alarm name and metric identity after verified deletion.
import json
from pathlib import Path

path = Path('/home/r/dev/minor/stackd/testdata/aws/cloudwatch/metric_insights_contributor_conversion.json')
prior = json.loads(path.read_text())
original = next(source['content'] for source in prior['sources'] if 'content' in source)
exec(compile(original.split('try:\n    actor = require(', 1)[0], '<first-probe-helpers>', 'exec'), globals())
CAP = prior
ALARM = CAP['owned_resources']['alarm']
NS = CAP['owned_resources']['namespace']
DIMS = CAP['owned_resources']['dimensions']
CAP['sources'].append({'path': __file__, 'invocation': 'positive-transition-controls', 'content': Path(__file__).read_text()})
CAP['first_invocation'] = {'failure': CAP.pop('failure', None), 'cleanup': CAP.pop('cleanup'), 'finished_at': CAP.pop('finished_at')}
CAP['limitations'].append('Initial same-threshold scalar SQL conversion retained grouped StateReasonData for 240 seconds; that interval is inconclusive about fresh scalar evaluation. A second invocation reuses the same alarm name and metric identity after deletion and uses explicit threshold-driven OK controls.')
CAP['protocol']['maximum_metric_samples'] = 80
sample_count = CAP['first_invocation']['cleanup']['published_samples']
known_id = CAP['initial_contributor_id']
created = False

try:
    actor = require('control-identity', 'get-caller-identity', {}, 'sts')
    if actor['Account'] != '000000000000':
        raise RuntimeError('Unexpected account')
    before = time.time()
    publish('control-initial')
    require('control-recreate-grouped', 'put-metric-alarm', config('grouped'))
    created = True
    evaluate('control-initial-grouped-alarm', 'grouped', 'ALARM', before)
    CAP['control_initial_contributor_id'] = known_id
    for mode in ['scalar-sql', 'metric']:
        require('control-convert-to-' + mode, 'put-metric-alarm', config(mode))
        inspect('control-' + mode + '-immediate')
        control = time.time()
        require('control-' + mode + '-raise-threshold', 'put-metric-alarm', config(mode, 200))
        evaluate('control-' + mode + '-positive-ok', mode, 'OK', control)
        inspect('control-' + mode + '-settled')
        back = time.time()
        require('control-' + mode + '-return-to-grouped', 'put-metric-alarm', config('grouped'))
        inspect('control-' + mode + '-grouped-immediate')
        evaluate('control-' + mode + '-grouped-reappearance', 'grouped', 'ALARM', back)
        CAP.setdefault('reappearance_identity', []).append({'from': mode, 'initial_id': CAP['control_initial_contributor_id'], 'reappeared_id': known_id, 'same_id': known_id == CAP['control_initial_contributor_id']})
    require('control-final-all-history', 'describe-alarm-history', {'AlarmName': ALARM, 'ScanBy': 'TimestampAscending', 'MaxRecords': 100})
except Exception as exc:
    CAP['failure'] = str(exc)
    print('Capture failure: ' + str(exc), flush=True)
finally:
    if created:
        require('control-cleanup-delete-alarm', 'delete-alarms', {'AlarmNames': [ALARM]})
        remaining = require('control-cleanup-describe-absence', 'describe-alarms', {'AlarmNames': [ALARM]})
        contributors = call('control-cleanup-contributors-absence', 'describe-alarm-contributors', {'AlarmName': ALARM})
        history('control-cleanup-retained-id-history')
        CAP['cleanup'] = {'alarm_absence_verified': not remaining.get('MetricAlarms') and not remaining.get('CompositeAlarms'), 'contributor_lookup_code': contributors['code'], 'metric_samples_persist_naturally': True, 'published_samples': sample_count}
    CAP['finished_at'] = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
    save()
    print(json.dumps({'fixture': str(OUT), 'failure': CAP.get('failure'), 'cleanup': CAP.get('cleanup')}), flush=True)
